basic_details.short_information: The CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (CSIR-NIIST) holds a walk-in interview on 20 November 2026, with reporting at 09.00 AM for Project Associate-I and 01.00 PM for Project Associate-II. Candidates report at CSIR-NIIST, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram (address on the notice: Industrial Estate PO, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram-695019). One post each is open under Advt. age_limit.details: The limit for both posts is 35 years (maximum), counted as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice gives age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and female candidates as per GOI/CSIR Rules; it prints no amounts.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology is a CSIR institute at Industrial Estate PO, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram. This notice invites eligible candidates to a walk-in interview to fill two purely temporary positions in Chemistry.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The higher amount applies to those who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET including lectureship / assistant professorship, or are GATE qualified, or have qualified National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and / or their agencies / Institutions. The lower amount applies to others who do not fulfil this. HRA of 20% is shown with both amounts. The limit for both posts is 35 years (maximum), counted as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice gives age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and female candidates as per GOI/CSIR Rules; it prints no amounts. Waitlisted candidates may be considered for any future project vacancies arising within a year from the date of interview, in the order of merit. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.pay: Rs.35,000/- + 20% HRA for NET/GATE qualified and equivalent; Rs.28,000/- + 20% HRA for others

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form, filled in and signed, with a recent colour passport-size photograph pasted on it. Self-attested copies of certificates and all marklists (matriculation onwards). Testimonials or certificates in support of age, educational qualification, experience and caste mentioned in the application. All original certificates and testimonials, for verification at the time of the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at CSIR-NIIST on the date and at the time shown against the post code. A written test will be conducted, if necessary. The notice describes no other stage and does not explain how marks or merit are decided.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary, and the declaration in the form states that the contractual appointment is purely temporary. Any change in the date of the walk-in interview will be notified on the website. Interim enquiries will not be attended to. If any material information is found concealed or distorted, the candidature or engagement is liable to be summarily terminated without notice. Persons with Benchmark disabilities (PwBD) who meet the eligibility conditions under GOI instructions are encouraged to attend.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CSIR-NIIST walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 20 November 2026 (20-11-26) for both Project Associate-I and Project Associate-II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I (CSTD-11) candidates report at 09.00 AM. Project Associate-II (CSTD-12) candidates report at 01.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in held?
faq.answer: Candidates report at CSIR-NIIST, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram. The institute address on the notice is Industrial Estate PO, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram-695019.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are two posts: one Project Associate-I and one Project Associate-II, each marked "One*".

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I needs an M.Sc in Chemistry from a recognized University or Equivalent. Project Associate-II needs an M.Sc in Chemistry or Physics from a recognized University or Equivalent, and 2 years of experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and female candidates as per GOI/CSIR Rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I gets Rs.31,000 for NET/GATE qualified candidates and equivalent, or Rs.25,000 for others. Project Associate-II gets Rs.35,000 or Rs.28,000 respectively. All amounts are monthly stipend plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, each stipend amount in the notice is printed as "+ 20% HRA".

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the signed application form with a photo pasted, self-attested copies of certificates and all marklists (matriculation onwards), and all original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: A written test will be conducted, if necessary. Candidates simply report on the date shown against their post code.
